title: Strict coefficient projection and the normalized limit coaugmentation
statement: Fix an exact ringed tensor edge e:A to B with isomorphic structural ring map, normalized augmented coefficient reductions rA,rB, normalized reduction pullback p, normalized strict tower direct image and limit comparison d, and a normalized tower adjunction a [def-sbc-strict-augmented-coefficient-presentation]. For normalized constant-limit isomorphisms jA,jB and every unbounded derived object E on B, kappa_A at e.right(E) followed by lA.L of projection e a p E equals e.right of kappa_B at E followed by d.a at rB(E). No perfectness, invertibility of the projection, boundedness or completeness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0944, 0E48 and 0A07; explicit strict augmented-complex refinement by E3

proof.text: On flat K-flat representatives the normalization of p.pull commutes with the strict augmentation: substitute the augmentation and pullback representative equations, then use naturality of canonical tensor pullback and its unit equation. In each total-complex summand the two maps insert the same coefficient unit; coefficient_augmentation identifies the last coefficient maps. Flat K-flat resolution descent gives the resulting whole-tower augmentation square.

source.place: Tags 0944, 0E48 and 0A07; explicit strict augmented-complex refinement by E3

proof.text: Transpose that augmentation square under a.adjunction. Naturality of the reduction augmentation moves the ambient counit through it. The normalized constant-tower comparison chi has transpose the constant ambient counit. The Hom bijection therefore gives augmentation_A followed by projection = chi followed by derived tower direct image of augmentation_B, in the derived category of strict towers.

source.place: Tags 0944, 0E48 and 0A07; explicit strict augmented-complex refinement by E3

proof.text: Apply lA.L. Naturality of d.a at augmentation_B moves this factor to e.right of lB.L of augmentation_B. The constant normalization of d.a and chi identifies jA followed by lA.L(chi) with e.right(jB) followed by d.a at the constant tower. Substitute kappa = j followed by limit of augmentation. Reassociation gives exactly the stated equation; neither augmentation nor projection is inverted.

theorem strictProjectionCoaugmentation
    (he : IsIso e.ringMap) (a : TowerAdjunction e d) (p : PullReduction e rA rB)
    (jA : ConstantLimit A lA) (jB : ConstantLimit B lB) (E : B.mateDerived) :
    (kappa rA lA jA).app (e.right.obj E) ≫ lA.L.map (projection e a p E) =
      e.right.map ((kappa rB lB jB).app E) ≫ d.a.hom.app (rB.functor.obj E)
